pages.text: Each molecule spends its time between the moving gas and the packing; how long sets its retention, k = k₀·e^(h·(1/T − 1/400 K)). The bands spread as they go: the plate height H = A + B/u + C·u (van Deemter) - eddies, diffusion along the column (worse when slow) and slow exchange with the packing (worse when fast). A column of length L has N = L/H plates, and two parts come out clean when Rs = (√N/4)·((α − 1)/α)·(k/(1 + k)) reaches 1.5.
$(thing)Set$(): Carrier flow, Column temperature.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Packing settles: the plate height varies by ±3%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): none beyond the recipe windows.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): The faster the carrier, the faster each run.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Plate height: H = A + B/u + C·u$(br)Plates: N = L/H$(br)Retention factor: k = k₀·e^(h(1/T − 1/T₀))$(br)Resolution: Rs = (√N/4)·((α−1)/α)·(k/(1+k))
